name: Johns Hopkins University
character: Most buildings on the Homewood campus are modeled after Federal architecture, with no structure taller than Gilman Hall.

landmarks.name: Gilman Hall
landmarks.quote: no structure can be taller than Gilman Hall, the flagship academic building.
landmarks.look: Flagship academic hall, tallest building on campus, Federal-style architecture.

landmarks.name: Milton S. Eisenhower Library
landmarks.quote: the Milton S. Eisenhower Library (the main library of the Homewood campus)
landmarks.look: Six-story library with only two stories above ground, shorter than Gilman Hall.

landmarks.name: Homewood House
landmarks.quote: Carroll's Homewood House is considered one of the finest examples of Federal architecture
landmarks.look: Historic house in classic Federal architecture style.

landmarks.name: Brody Learning Commons
landmarks.quote: A four-story expansion to the library, known as the Brody Learning Commons
landmarks.look: Four-story library expansion attached to the main library.

landmarks.name: Hutzler Reading Room
landmarks.quote: the Hutzler Reading Room ("The Hut") in Gilman Hall
landmarks.look: Reading room located inside Gilman Hall.
